steps.title: What You Will Learn
steps.text: This unit covers the full testing pyramid for Surgewave: unit tests with embedded broker, mocking for isolation, integration tests with fixtures, Testcontainers, and benchmarking with BenchmarkDotNet.

steps.title: Embedded Broker Testing
steps.text: The fastest way to test Surgewave is with an embedded broker running in-memory. Lesson 2.1 shows you how to spin up a broker per test with zero external dependencies.

steps.title: Mocking for Unit Tests
steps.text: For pure unit tests without any broker, mock Surgewave interfaces like IProducer and IConsumer. This keeps tests fast and focused on your business logic.

steps.title: Integration Test Fixtures
steps.text: Share broker instances across tests using xUnit fixtures for efficient integration testing. Lesson 2.3 covers the IAsyncLifetime pattern.

steps.title: Benchmarking with BenchmarkDotNet
steps.text: Measure your Surgewave application performance with BenchmarkDotNet. Lesson 2.5 teaches you to write benchmarks and interpret throughput and allocation results.
